about: Machine-readable risk models (RFC §11, Tech Design §6.1). A model runs only when enabled and every threshold is verified against a cited source: K-State, UNL or CSU extension for the demo set (source.type 'extension'); 'fallback' marks another agency or peer-reviewed source; 'calibration' marks an internal remote-sensing calibration that is not an agronomic threshold. 'MMDD' values are dates (910 = 10 September). Values filled from the sources and verified by the team on 2026-11-14.

source.title: Western Corn Rootworm Early Season Management in Kansas (MF3456)
source.quote: Emphasize crop rotation… larvae only feed on corn roots the following season. They are only a problem in continuous corn.
source.note: Nebraska: UNL CropWatch, Considerations for Managing Corn Rootworm (2025): rotation-resistant variants are not present in Nebraska; crop rotation interrupts the life cycle. https://cropwatch.unl.edu/considerations-managing-corn-rootworm-its-not-too-late/

source.title: Wheat Planting: Be Cautious of Planting Too Early (eUpdate 1118)
source.quote: Planting wheat after the BPMD reduces the risk of problems with aphids and barley yellow dwarf. … Zone 1: September 10-30
source.note: Earliest Kansas zone (Zone 1, 10 Sep) as a statewide rule: never flags a field sown inside its own zone's window, may miss early sowing in Zones 2–4 (15 Sep, 25 Sep, 5 Oct) until the county zone is set. Deadline = first freeze in the forecast: K-State MF2823 'numbers usually start to decline with the onset of cold weather' (no temperature given).

source.title: Wheat Streak Mosaic (MF3383)
source.quote: should be dead and dry for 2 weeks before planting the new wheat crop
source.note: Nebraska: UNL CropWatch (2022) 'Volunteer should be completely dead at least two weeks before planting.' https://cropwatch.unl.edu/2022/wheat-disease-update-barley-yellow-dwarf-and-wheat-streak-mosaic

source.title: Wheat Streak Mosaic Virus (R.L. Bowden)
source.quote: volunteer must be killed within 1/4 to 1/2 mile of the new field
source.note: ½ mile ≈ 805 m. Only used to name what the image can't show (neighbouring volunteer); no distance source for Colorado/Nebraska.

source.title: Terrasight calibration: green cover vs bare soil on Sentinel-2 NDVI
source.note: Not an agronomic threshold: bare or dead residue reads below ~0.3 on Sentinel-2 NDVI, actively growing cover above it. No extension source gives an NDVI value.
